title: Learning Care at Willow House
paras: At Willow House, a small fictional [[nursing|nursing]] school, Maya began her first practical lesson beside the stone [[pillar|pillar]] supporting the entrance roof. Through a window she could see the practice beds. They held training models, not real patients, but she still worried about making mistakes in front of her classmates.

Her tutor, Amara, first asked everyone to watch a [[sparrow|sparrow]] on the garden wall and describe exactly what it did. Maya wrote that it looked hungry, then realised she had guessed rather than observed. Inside, Amara used a bag containing two red counters and eight white ones to explain [[probability|probability]]. Each student drew one without looking to select a practice task; red meant checking the bed.

Maya drew red. She examined the [[mechanism|mechanism]] that raised the bed's upper section, then collected equipment for a movement exercise used in [[therapy|therapy]]. Her first preparation took ten minutes. Could she [[halve|halve]] that time by placing everything within reach? On her second attempt, she finished in five minutes. Next, a classmate played someone afraid to move. This required patient [[persuasion|persuasion]], not faster hands.

During the review, Maya described the [[impact|impact]] of switching roles: being hurried had made her reluctant to cooperate. Assessment was [[ongoing|ongoing]], so Amara asked her to repeat the conversation next week. Maya put a reminder beside her equipment plan: ask what worries the person before explaining the exercise.
zh: 在一所虚构的小型护理学校柳屋，玛雅站在支撑入口屋顶的石柱旁，开始了第一堂实践课。透过窗户，她能看到练习用的病床。床上放着训练模型，而不是真正的病人，但她仍然担心在同学面前犯错。
导师阿玛拉先让大家观察花园围墙上的一只麻雀，准确描述它做了什么。玛雅写道，它看起来饿了，随后意识到自己是在猜测，而不是观察。进屋后，阿玛拉用一个装有两枚红色筹码和八枚白色筹码的袋子讲解概率。每位学生都不看袋内，抽出一枚来决定练习任务；红色表示检查病床。
玛雅抽到了红色。她检查了抬起床头部分的机械装置，然后收集一种治疗用活动练习所需的器材。第一次准备花了十分钟。把所有东西放在伸手可及的位置，能让她把时间减半吗？第二次尝试时，她五分钟就完成了。接着，一位同学扮演害怕活动的人。这需要耐心劝说，而不是加快手上的动作。
复盘时，玛雅描述了交换角色带来的影响：受到催促让她不愿配合。考核仍在进行，因此阿玛拉让她下周再练一次这段对话。玛雅在器材安排计划旁写下一条提醒：先询问对方担心什么，再解释练习内容。

q.s: The practice beds held training models rather than real patients.
q.why: 首段明确说明床上是训练模型而非病人。

q.s: Maya’s second preparation took more than half as long as her first.
q.why: 两次分别用时十分钟和五分钟，恰好减半。

q.s: Maya’s next conversation practice would be with the same classmate.
q.why: 末段未说明下周与谁练习对话。
